items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I went to hear a Thad Jones band

ctx.x: Ray's in very bad shape now, (inaudible)

Yeah, I saw him last Christmas, I was in New York, I went to hear a Thad Jones band, and Ray stood right beside me and he gave me that smile. You know, that vacant smile, you know where I know you from someplace. This. So finally -- I wouldn't tell him for a while, and finally I told him who I was and bought him a drink, you know, okay. But now --
But liquor did that to Ray, and (inaudible) the pills and all the substitute things --
